summary: Verified CSS-only contrast fix on Location Intelligence page and regression across other pages. All 6 acceptance criteria exercised via browser checks; all passed. Pre-existing backend pytest suite (118 tests) re-run as a sanity check since no backend code changed for this fix.

checks.criterion: Low-contrast/invisible text bug fix: uppercase micro-labels ('.eyebrow') on Location Intelligence are legible
checks.name: eyebrow-contrast-legible
checks.evidence: All non-empty .eyebrow elements (STEP 2 · STATE, MIN SCORE, MIN CATCHMENT, STEP 6 · CANDIDATE LOCATIONS, etc.) computed color rgb(71, 85, 105) and font-size 11px; all visible. Run against public URL https://district-dive.preview.emergentagent.com/location-intelligence.

checks.criterion: Disabled drill-down selects still show readable placeholder text before a parent is chosen
checks.name: disabled-selects-readable-placeholder
checks.evidence: On first load, disabled District trigger shows 'Select district' and Town/City trigger shows 'Select town/city', both with opacity 1 and computed color rgb(100, 116, 139).

checks.name: input-placeholders-readable
checks.evidence: ::placeholder computed color for both filter-min-score ('0-100') and filter-min-population ('e.g. 50000') is rgb(100, 116, 139) with opacity 1.

checks.criterion: Muted helper text is readable (hint + Tier- table cells)
checks.name: muted-helper-text-readable
checks.evidence: Hint '— select a state to begin the drill-down' computed color channels <= rgb(100,116,139), i.e. darker/equal; visible.

checks.criterion: No functional regression in the drill-down flow (state -> district -> town/city -> candidate locations with map)
checks.name: drilldown-flow-no-regression
checks.evidence: Selected Uttar Pradesh -> ranked districts table loaded (Lucknow visible) -> selected Lucknow district -> towns/cities ranked (Hazratganj 82, Lucknow 78, Gomti Nagar 77) -> selected Hazratganj -> STEP 6 CANDIDATE LOCATIONS table with scores (31, 30) and geospatial map rendered. No HTTP >= 400, no serious console errors.

checks.criterion: Contrast fix did not break other pages (Dashboard, Opportunity Map, AI Consultant/Consultant, Recommendations, Sources & Methodology)
checks.name: other-pages-render-no-regression
checks.evidence: Visited /, /opportunity-map, /consultant, /recommendations, /methodology; each main heading visible with non-transparent computed color; no serious console errors. (Routes are /consultant and /methodology per App.tsx, not /ai-consultant or /sources-methodology.)

backend_sanity.note: No new backend test file added — this fix is CSS-only (frontend/src/index.css), no API-bearing criteria in this matrix.
